explication: Llama is a macOS menu-bar application for installing and running local GGUF language models through llama.cpp. The principal workflow is to discover or resolve a model, download it into the shared Hugging Face cache, register it as installed, and serve it locally for the built-in WebUI or API clients. The menu also manages server and model actions, while settings control server behavior, network exposure, and model overrides. The graph uses README statements and indexed or excerpted references; unsampled implementation details are not assumed.
